verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama has a CLI (`ollama run`, `ollama pull`, `ollama rm`, `ollama launch`) and a local REST API server. However, no item documents a command to start or stop that server; `ollama launch` starts coding tools, not the server itself. The axis applies to a local model runtime, so the lack of evidence gives "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line
